newsitem.title: LIBERIA: Mass grave unearthed in Liberia massacre town.
newsitem.headline: Mass grave unearthed in Liberia massacre town.

text.p: Health workers have exhumed 21 bodies from a mass grave in a Liberian town where scores of people were massacred by rebels last week, officials said on Friday.
Chief pathologist Dr Isaac Moses told reporters most of the decomposing bodies were of women or children, shot at close range, stabbed or battered to death with blunt objects.
Moses said residents believed up to 70 bodies were buried in shallow mass graves around the town of Senje in Liberia's western Cape Mount county where the massacres occurred.
"There are more mass graves around Senje and locals have said more than 70 corpses are believed to be in them," Moses told reporters in the capital Monrovia.
